title: 第7章 泼妇上门挑衅砸她房子第8章 村长出来拉偏架
content_zh:
;;
即便是儿子亲口说出来，李为民也还是感觉在做梦，很是难以置信。
他伸出布满老茧的手，颤颤巍巍摸向儿子脸庞，
当看到儿子异常坚定的眼神中再也不见一丝痴傻，他才意识到梦寐以求的事真的发生了。
瞬间老泪纵横，无数的心酸苦楚一起涌上心头。
“好了，真的好了，老天爷终于开眼了。”
曾几何时，成绩无比优秀的儿子是他全部的骄傲，期待着他学业有成干出一番大事业光耀门楣。
但现在，他只想要儿子正常的活着就十分心满意足。
“向东，你先坐下歇息，爸去给你做饭！”
李为民擦干净眼泪飞快的冲进屋子，把桌子上早就准备好的咸菜豆腐倒进大黄的狗盆里。
破旧的土砖房里屋。
听到门外动静的的刘月红从床上穿好衣服爬起来，不可思议的看着老头发癫般的举动。
立即心疼的过来制止。
“老家伙，你干什么，向东还没回来吃呐！”
李为民自从儿子出事，就变得沉默寡言，今天却异常亢奋。
伸手拦住相濡以沫的老婆激动道：
“今天不吃这个，你赶紧去杀只鸡熬汤，我再去打条鱼回来！”
“我们加餐庆祝！”
刘月红一听懵了。
家里的鸡就那么十几只，都是下蛋母鸡，要卖钱来还债贴补家用的。

老头子这是跟着儿子也疯了吗？
正当她满心疑惑之际，李向东走进来，大步来到刘月红面前噗通一声跪下。
“妈！对不起，这些日子让们操心受累了。”
刘月红瞧着儿子久未见过的懂事模样，立即捂住嘴巴发出一声惊呼。
“向东，你的病......”
“好了！”李向东站起身，扶住母亲手臂道：“我好了。”
刘月红当场抑制不住内心的激动，哇的一声扑进儿子怀中痛哭流涕。
自从儿子出事后，他们夫妻的天就塌了。
老爷子和儿子沉重的医药费压得他们喘不过气。
他们借遍了村里每一户人家，债台高筑，最后老爷子没了，儿子还是痴傻。
五六十万巨款全部打了水漂。
就连老爷子的后事也是村里人无偿资助，才匆匆收尾上山。
这两年里，他们几乎没过过一天好日子。
content_en:

Even if his son said it himself, Li Weimin still felt like he was dreaming, which was very unbelievable.
He stretched out his calloused hands and touched his son's face tremblingly.
When he saw his son's extremely determined eyes no longer showing any trace of stupidity, he realized that what he had dreamed of had really happened.
In an instant, I burst into tears, and countless sorrows and pains surged into my heart.
"Okay, really okay, God finally opened his eyes."
Once upon a time, his son, who had extremely good grades, was all his pride, and he looked forward to his success in school, his great career, and the glory of his family.
But now, he just wants his son to live a normal life and is very satisfied.
"Xiangdong, sit down and rest first, and dad will cook for you!"
Li Weimin wiped away his tears and rushed into the house quickly, pouring the pickled vegetables and tofu that had been prepared on the table into Rhubarb's dog bowl.
The back room of a dilapidated adobe house.
Hearing the movement outside the door, Liu Yuehong got up from the bed, put on her clothes, and looked at the old man's crazy behavior in disbelief.
Immediately, distressed, he came over to stop him.
"Old guy, what are you doing? Xiangdong hasn't come back to eat yet!"
Li Weimin has become taciturn since his son's accident, but today he is extremely excited.
He stretched out his hand to stop the loving wife and said excitedly:
"If you don't want to eat this today, you go kill a chicken and make soup, and I'll go catch a fish and come back!"
“Let’s celebrate with an extra meal!”
Liu Yuehong was stunned when she heard this.
There are only a dozen chickens at home, all of which are egg-laying hens, and they have to be sold to pay off debts and support the family.
Is the old man going crazy following his son?
Just when she was filled with doubts, Li Xiangdong walked in, strode to Liu Yuehong and knelt down in front of Liu Yuehong.
"Mom! I'm sorry, we have been so worried and tired these days."
Liu Yuehong looked at her son's sensible appearance that she hadn't seen in a long time, and immediately covered her mouth and let out an exclamation.
"Xiangdong, your illness..."
"Okay!" Li Xiangdong stood up, held his mother's arm and said, "I'm okay."
Liu Yuehong couldn't restrain her inner excitement on the spot, and threw herself into her son's arms with a cry and burst into tears.
Since their son's accident, the sky has fallen apart for the couple.
The old man and his son were overwhelmed by the heavy medical expenses.
They borrowed money from every house in the village and accumulated huge debts. In the end, the old man died, but his son was still stupid.
All the huge sum of 500,000 to 600,000 yuan was wasted.
Even the old man’s funeral was financed free of charge by the villagers before he hurried up the mountain.
In the past two years, they had hardly had a good day.
